label: Langkawi
short_description: Loyalty-program beach resorts across Langkawi, from the Pantai Tengah and Cenang strip to the quieter northwest coves.
intro: Langkawi's hotels in this directory are beach resorts spread around the duty-free island in the Andaman Sea: the Pantai Tengah and Pantai Cenang strip on the southwest, the island's liveliest beach-and-dining area; and quieter luxury coves further north and west, set against the island's rainforest and mangrove backdrop. The portfolio skews luxury and resort-style, all a short drive from Langkawi International Airport (LGK).
